in_hebrew.name: פנחו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'panah' meaning 'face, presence, favor'. The name Pancho is not directly found in the Bible, but it embodies the biblical concept of God's favor.

in_greek.name: Πάνχος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'panchos' meaning 'all'. The name Pancho is not directly found in the Bible, but it can be associated with the Greek meaning of the name 'Pan' meaning 'all' and 'chus' meaning 'god'.

in_latin.name: Pancho
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Pancho is not directly found in the Bible or in the Latin language. It is a Spanish name derived from the Basque name 'Epancho' meaning 'strong' or 'mighty'.
